description: Main window. Of Tauri's core, only listening for MyOrbiter's own events (and stopping); no windows, webviews, paths, menus or other core commands. No dialog permission: MyOrbiter's native dialogs (TennoScope's program, a step back to an older build, a new Discord webhook) open from Rust. No opener permission: links open through MyOrbiter's own open_link command, which allows https to its sites only (src-tauri/src/link.rs, the same list as src/lib/core/links.ts), and MyOrbiter's log folders open from Rust too. Of the process plugin, only restart (after an update is installed); updates themselves go through MyOrbiter's own commands (updates.rs), so none of the updater plugin's commands are allowed.
